hypotheses.reasoning: Lock contention: at 06:00:31 the catalog-db transaction 88973 from catalog-svc-reconciler sat idle in transaction while holding RowExclusiveLock on products (#128). Other UPDATEs on products then waited on its ShareLock (#140, #150), and catalog-svc queries hit the 10s statement timeout (#146, #152, #170). That made search-api's CatalogClient calls time out at 15s, its HTTP pool to catalog-svc filled up (50/50) and checkouts timed out, and web-bff returned 504s from 06:04. The translation API reset at 05:55 was a one-off that succeeded on retry (#73), so it is a red herring. I found no deploy lines.
The same events can be read as search-api timing out on its catalog-svc dependency. But those timeouts are caused by the DB lock, so this is a symptom, not the origin.
There was a brief translation API connection reset, but it recovered on retry, about 7 minutes before the onset.

verdict.recommendedAction: Kill the idle-in-transaction reconciler session on catalog-db (pg_terminate_backend for the backend running txn 88973). Set idle_in_transaction_session_timeout for the catalog-svc-reconciler role, and fix the reconciler so it commits or rolls back promptly. Watch the search-api to catalog-svc pool drain and the 504 rate recover.
